title: EML basics
explain: Programmatic access to RAP BOs. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "EML basics" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without EML basics, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of EML basics without a failure story
howToApply: Use EML basics explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “EML basics” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (EML → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Discount approval near S/4 — choose placement using EML basics without core mods.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “EML basics” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “EML basics”.

designTradeoffs.optionA: Managed RAP for standard CRUD patterns
designTradeoffs.whenChooseA: Standard BO lifecycle with framework help
designTradeoffs.whenChooseB: Complex legacy persistence you must own

designTradeoffs.risk: Draft without cleanup creates lock/orphan debt
